# LX Software

> Independent software studio, Hong Kong.

Independent software studio in Hong Kong. I design and ship software that stays fast, legible, and easy to change.

## Contact

- Email: hello@lx-software.com
- Telephone, WhatsApp, and WeChat appear on the contact section when they are configured at build time. Those values are not stored in the repository.
